pages.title: GEL.IT.UP by GIUP® | Official Distributor Information

h2: Superior Innovation for Professional Nail Markets

paragraphs: GEL.IT.UP by GIUP® has supported nail professionals since 2011 with high-performance systems, trend-driven color development, and consistent product quality designed for distributor growth.
This website is the official information hub for prospective and active distribution partners. Portal access is granted only after contract confirmation and approval.
Our professional lineup covers Soak-off Gel Polish, Base and Top Coats, Builder System, Nail Polishes, Nail Art, Consumables, and Skin & Nail Care.
The range is built for professionals who need reliable product performance, broad shade availability, and practical system compatibility across services.
Our product and operations philosophy aligns with EU regulatory requirements and GMP-oriented practices, with strict quality control standards across sourcing and production workflows.
GEL.IT.UP by GIUP® is committed to cruelty-free principles and maintains recognized cruelty-free standards in line with Leaping Bunny expectations.
Distributors receive region-focused onboarding, launch guidance, and practical growth support including approved media assets and brand support materials.
Commercial setup is tailored by territory, business type, and expected volume so each partner can launch with a practical, scalable assortment strategy.
To begin, submit the distributor application form with your company details and market profile so our team can evaluate fit and respond with the next steps.
Our distribution team reviews each application manually and confirms approved partners by email before enabling access to wholesale systems and account workflows.
